## Vapi tool server A
Tools: **check_availability**, **book_viewing**, **search_listings**.
Vapi calls each tool's own webhook, the workflow replies in the `{results:[{toolCallId,result}]}` format and only afterwards syncs the CRM, so a slow CRM never delays the call.
